content: C64-specific prior art: mwenge/iridisalpha (Jeff Minter's Iridis Alpha, 64tass+VICE+Exomizer, src/bin/demos/docs/orig/utils layout); mwenge/gridrunner (explicit MD5 byte-for-byte verification loop while incrementally recovering source, Regenerator/Infiltrator disassemblers, generic e84F8-style labels promoted to UpdateShipPosition-style names as understanding grows); Piddewitt/C64-Game-Source-Code (Loderunner, Castles of Dr Creep; explicit goal 'reassembles to an exact copy of the original binary' for originals/, PLUS a parallel mods/ tree where source is made maximally 'variable' - symbolic labels, configurable addresses - specifically to allow code/data relocation and modification, i.e. byte-identity is the originals-tree gate and is deliberately abandoned in the mods tree).
